finding: src/anomaly/review.py:594 The report-body API remains a second reachable P7-completion path: write_report defaults complete_readme=True, while complete_report_readme verifies only findings/report and not the chart output or chart receipt.
rationale: The public write_report API is directly importable and still marks README status complete/P7 before charts run, because its default invokes a helper whose only preconditions are findings.json and report.md; only the installed dispatcher opts out and sequences charts first.

evidence.output: write_report(root, *, complete_readme: bool = True) writes report.md and, when the default is retained, calls complete_report_readme; that helper checks only findings/findings.json and findings/report.md, then writes 'Status: complete' and 'Last completed phase: P7' to README.md.

The canonical dispatcher avoids the bug only by calling write_report(root, complete_readme=False), then generate_charts(root), then complete_report_readme(root); the direct mainline API test separately calls write_report(root) before generate_charts(root), proving the default path remains reachable.

The report API contract test asserts write_report leaves state.json unchanged yet puts 'Status: complete' in README; generate_charts is the separate operation that creates findings/charts and .anomaly/receipts/charts.json, neither of which complete_report_readme validates.
